title: Conversational Memory Module
summary: This module provides various memory implementations for managing conversation history in AI applications, ranging from simple buffers to token-limited summaries and vector store-backed long-term memory.

nodes.label: Base Memory Abstraction
nodes.title: Base Memory Abstraction
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface for all memory components, including methods for loading and saving context.

nodes.label: Base Chat Memory
nodes.title: Base Chat Memory
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chat-based memory, managing message history with input/output key handling. Note: Does not support native tool calling.

nodes.label: Simple Conversation Buffer
nodes.title: Conversation Buffer Memory
nodes.description: Stores the entire conversation history as a buffer, either as a string or a list of messages, without any summarization or pruning.

nodes.label: String Buffer Memory
nodes.title: Conversation String Buffer Memory
nodes.description: Stores conversation history as a single string, suitable for models that process string-based inputs rather than structured chat messages.

nodes.label: Sliding Window Memory
nodes.title: Conversation Buffer Window Memory
nodes.description: Retains only the most recent 'k' turns of a conversation, discarding older messages to manage context length.

nodes.label: Summarizing Memory
nodes.title: Conversation Summary Memory
nodes.description: Continuously summarizes the conversation history, updating the summary after each turn to provide a concise context to the model.

nodes.label: Summary Buffer with Token Limit
nodes.title: Conversation Summary Buffer Memory
nodes.description: Combines a running summary with recent messages, pruning older messages into the summary when a maximum token limit is exceeded.

nodes.label: Vector Store Backed Memory
nodes.title: Vector Store Token Buffer Memory
nodes.description: Stores older conversation parts in a vector store for long-term retrieval, combining them with recent messages and timestamps for context.

nodes.label: Chat Message History
nodes.title: Base Chat Message History
nodes.description: Interface for storing and retrieving chat messages, used by chat memory implementations.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: Provides core language model capabilities, used for tasks like summarization and token counting.

nodes.label: Vector Store Retriever
nodes.title: Vector Store Retriever
nodes.description: Component for retrieving relevant documents or information from a vector database based on similarity.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Recursive Character Text Splitter
nodes.description: Utility for splitting long texts into smaller, manageable chunks, often used before embedding or storing in vector stores.

nodes.label: Human/AI Messages
nodes.title: Human and AI Messages
nodes.description: Represents distinct messages from human users and AI assistants in a conversation.

nodes.label: System Message Template
nodes.title: System Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A prompt template specifically for generating system-level instructions or context for an LLM.

nodes.label: Summarization Engine
nodes.title: Summarization Engine
nodes.description: Internal logic for generating concise summaries of conversation segments, often powered by an LLM.

groups.label: Memory Abstractions
groups.title: Memory Abstractions
groups.description: Base classes and interfaces that define the structure and common functionalities for memory components.

groups.label: Core Memory Implementations
groups.title: Core Memory Implementations
groups.description: Concrete classes providing various strategies for managing conversational history.

groups.label: Summarization Components
groups.title: Summarization Components
groups.description: Components specifically involved in generating and managing conversation summaries.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Components from other modules that are utilized by the conversational memory implementations.
